name: SparseGS
aliases: Sparse View Synthesis Using 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: Uses monocular depth + diffusion priors for ~3-view input.
summary: SparseGS is a sparse-view 3D reconstruction method that stabilizes training by combining monocular depth priors with diffusion-based Score Distillation Sampling to address misplaced Gaussians and geometry collapse.
